description:
LocalTranslate is an offline translation application that uses Firefox's neural translation models (from the mozilla/firefox-translations-models project) to perform high-quality translations locally on your device.

Note: LocalTranslate is not affiliated with The Mozilla Foundation in any way.

LocalTranslate supports the following languages:

• Arabic (ar)

• Azerbaijani (az)

• Belarusian (be)

• Bulgarian (bg)

• Bengali (bn)

• Bosnian (bs)

• Catalan (ca)

• Czech (cs)

• Danish (da)

• German (de)

• Greek (el)

• English (en)

• Spanish (es)

• Estonian (et)

• Persian (fa)

• Finnish (fi)

• French (fr)

• Gujarati (gu)

• Hebrew (he)

• Hindi (hi)

• Croatian (hr)

• Hungarian (hu)

• Indonesian (id)

• Icelandic (is)
